query:
SELECT DISTINCT le.customerId, c.fullName,
       (SELECT le2.balanceAfterUsd FROM ledgerEntries le2 WHERE le2.customerId = le.customerId ORDER BY le2.createdAt DESC LIMIT 1) as latestBalance
FROM ledgerEntries le 
JOIN customers c ON le.customerId = c.id 
HAVING CAST(latestBalance AS DECIMAL(12,2)) > 0
ORDER BY latestBalance DESC
LIMIT 30;
